name: mounjaro-price-index
description: Live UK Mounjaro price index — iOS app

scripts.ios:sync: npx cap sync ios && python3 pipeline/strip_cachebusters.py
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17" -derivedDataPath /tmp/glpen-dd CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.android:sync: npx cap sync android && python3 pipeline/strip_cachebusters.py
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
